meaning: Unbalanced load error: laundry is piled on one side of the drum and the washer could not even it out.
causes: Laundry not evenly distributed, for example from incorrect use of a laundry net
Load too large or too small
Items not suited to machine washing (pillows, cushions, bathroom mats, carpets, electric blankets, curtains, rubber mats)
diySteps: Pause the washer, take the laundry out and spread it evenly in the drum, then choose an appropriate spin cycle
Aim for a load of about 2/3 of the drum capacity
Wash blankets with the Duvet cycle and padded or down jackets with the Sportswear cycle, both at medium spin speed
If you use a laundry net, fill it only to 2/3 and wash two or three nets together with some clothes rather than one net alone

Rock the washer from the front, back and side to check for unevenness; adjust the leg on the side the unit tilts with a wrench until the legs sit firmly on the floor, and check with a level on the top plate
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If UE keeps returning on a level washer with a normal load, request LG service.
